summary: The index measures the performance of U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (“TIPS”) with maturities from 1 month up to (but not including) 13 months. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments LLC seeks to achieve the fund’s investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund’s net assets in TIPS with maturities of 1-13 months. The fund is non-diversified.
